reason: I'll let my son do it while the school makes it free homework, but I already pay his tuition teacher every month and she sits with him in person. I'm not paying extra for another app on top of that.
objection: More screen time is the last thing my child needs, and I trust a real teacher who can see his face more than a screen that tells me he's 'behind'.
would_change_my_mind: If the end-of-term re-test showed his gap topics clearly closed and his tuition teacher could also see the report and use it, so it replaces some tuition cost instead of adding to it.
